actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Accepted for the class contract; a MuJoCo reset restores the model defaults (mj_resetData) and does not use a seed

facts.text: The repository is archived, targets the deprecated mujoco_py bindings, is Panda-specific and is no longer maintained; it is superseded by mujoco_robot

The project provides Franka Emika Panda robot model definitions for MuJoCo, a MuJoCo-based robot simulator, a Python 3 API for controlling and monitoring the simulated robot, direct position and torque controllers, and a task-space hybrid force motion controller
The robot models are in mujoco_panda/models and the API is documented in MujocoRobot and PandaArm
The library requires mujoco_py, numpy, scipy and quaternion, and it is used after sourcing set_env.sh
The main scene is the MJCF model named mujoco_panda_model
The main scene includes other/simple_scene.xml and panda/assets.xml and pulls in the arm_with_gripper body tree, the torque_with_gripper actuators and the ft_sensor sensors
The main scene selects the elliptic contact cone and enables gravity; its option element sets no timestep
The seven arm joints are hinges named panda_joint1 to panda_joint7 with ranges: joints 1, 3, 5 and 7 +-2.8973, joint 2 +-1.7628, joint 4 -3.0718 to -0.4 and joint 6 -1.6573 to 2.1127
The end-effector site is ee_site on panda_link7
The hand has two slide joints, panda_finger_joint1 and panda_finger_joint2, each with range 0 to 0.04 m
The actuator block has seven motor actuators with ctrlrange +-87 for arm joints 1 to 4 and +-12 for arm joints 5 to 7, plus two position actuators for the gripper fingers with ctrlrange 0 to 0.04
The model carries a force sensor and a torque sensor at ee_site
The asset block compiles angles in radians and declares the collision and visual STL meshes

gaps: the fake backend is a stand-in for the mujoco library, not MuJoCo: it reads the MJCF and its includes for the actuator control ranges, the joint dimensions and the option timestep but integrates a placeholder first-order motion of each actuated joint toward its control value

the seven arm actuators are torque channels in the model and the two gripper actuators are position channels, while the stand-in treats every actuator as a position target, so the fake's trajectories are not the model's torque dynamics
no mesh, texture, material or inertia is loaded and no contact, friction, tendon, equality or actuator constraint of the model is resolved; the force and torque sensors at ee_site are not read
the model sets no timestep, so the engine default applies; the stand-in uses a placeholder library default and the published timestep_ms comes from that fake
MuJoCo itself was not importable where the gate ran, so no trajectory of this package was compared with the real engine or with the upstream mujoco_py simulator
no viewer, rendering or camera stream is exposed: the package serves only the cap.world.* integration state and control vector
only the card's first model, franka_panda.xml, is served; the no-gripper, position-actuator and block-table scenes are other models and are not part of this driver
no physical Franka Emika Panda is modelled and nothing was validated against hardware

measures.description: Declared native checkpoint. Integration profile restores the full native input vector; basic profile restores only advertised state plus actuator activation and exact native time. Neither profile certifies external callbacks, plugins, RNG or hardware fidelity.
measures.name: native_checkpoint

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the integration state is kept and stays readable
